evidence: The IDF-SVD gain survives two leakage checks.
observation: On 879 exactly degree-matched queries (5,220 pairs, 16.84% positive) the SVD ensemble scored 0.436267/0.544888 while disease degree was at chance (0.167494/0.167992). A degree-preserving target permutation dropped the real 0.445936/0.509497 to 0.279272/0.249671, so F-0040 reads the gain as association-pattern signal rather than degree or topology.
subject: F-47
title: IDF-SVD survives exact-degree and permutation checks
